purpose: Define rollout-safe outcome/axis-first selection of approved cumulative assessment fragments inside the existing Recovery session materializer.

rollout_policy.partial_pool: A partially authored Curriculum v2 fragment pool must not silently take over from the legacy cumulative mapping path.
rollout_policy.activation_gate: The v2 fragment path activates per enrollment/session only when approved compatible fragments meet the minimum axis-coverage and budget gate for that session type.
rollout_policy.after_activation: Once an enrollment has used Curriculum v2 cumulative fragments, inability to find fresh independent forms is a content gap and must never fall back to reused or weaker legacy evidence.

compatibility_rules: Fragment status is approved and active.
Exercise is published and its registered version is approved.
Enrollment school year is included in fragment year_profiles.
Mocks require transfer fragments; checkpoint may use transfer or controlled_performance fragments.
Every primary fragment outcome is required in the learner's active Curriculum v2 scope.
The fragment has at least one required primary outcome.
freshness_rules: A form_family_key already present in cumulative outcome evidence for the enrollment is not fresh.
A form_family_key already assigned in an earlier Recovery cumulative session is not fresh even if the learner abandoned the attempt.
The same form_family_key cannot be selected twice inside one cumulative session.
selection_priority: blocking outcomes with missing or weak cumulative evidence
transfer fragments before controlled-performance fragments when otherwise equivalent
smaller fragments when evidence priority is equivalent so session time can cover more required axes

mock_intermediate.coverage_target: all active axes that fit the session budget, prioritizing blocking and under-evidenced axes

mock_final.hard_gate: If any active blocking axis has no fresh selected primary-axis fragment, the final mock is returned as a content gap rather than materialized incompletely.

budget_policy: Selected Curriculum v2 fragments must fit within the declared Recovery session budget.
The rollout gate includes a minimum-budget feasibility check so a technically present but unusable pool does not take over early.
Non-grammar axes are considered before grammar during the first coverage pass so required skill tasks cannot be crowded out by short grammar items.
When multiple axes are active, additional grammar selection cannot exceed the session-specific grammar ceiling.

assignment_policy.visible_labels: Use neutral Parte labels and never reveal the tested outcome, grammar rule or competence axis.
assignment_policy.mock_feedback: Intermediate and final mocks continue to suppress score, correct-answer, explanation and diagnostic feedback during the attempt.
assignment_policy.legacy_non_cumulative_behavior: Topic, quick-review and error-review materialization remains on the existing recovery_exercise_map path.
